sanjay: Quick follow-up after today's canary: sidecar fastpath looks promising but we hit a stale-policy detection on pop-az1. Need consensus on quarantine behavior.

elaine: What did stale-policy detection look like operationally?

sanjay: Sidecar reported policy_epoch mismatch vs control-plane and started rejecting stamped tokens. Some clients saw failures for ~90s while operators rolled the pop into quarantine.

mike: That sounds like intended safety, but 90s is noisy. Can we shorten operator manual actions by adding an automated short-circuit: when mismatch_count > N within T, auto-quarantine?

alyssa: I'm wary of auto-quarantine for small POPs. It could cause traffic storms. Proposal: auto-quarantine only if mismatch_rate > 5% AND healthcheck failures > 0.5%. Otherwise, trigger ops alert for manual review.

elaine: Also need a visible metric in the console: current policy_epoch, last_seen_epoch, mismatch_rate per POP. Operators should see a one-click quarantine button.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary pop-az1 applied sidecar v0.3 -> healthchecks OK.

sanjay: Agreed on instrumentation. For automation: make auto-quarantine gated by a cluster-wide feature-flag and only enabled during chaos windows. Ops plays should include a fast-unquarantine route after policy sync.

mike: Small implementation detail: sidecar should emit a decision_event with fields: decision_id, policy_epoch, local_epoch, action_taken. That makes debugging mismatches easier.

alyssa: I'll add the metric tiles + the quarantine button to the runbook dashboard. Also will draft the auto-quarantine flag gating rules.

elaine: Security note: ensure quarantine command requires two-person approval or an ops override with audit stamp. We don't want accidental mass quarantines.

sanjay: Sounds good. Next steps: 1) add metrics + button, 2) implement decision_event, 3) document quarantine/unquarantine CLI and UI flow. Anyone object?

mike: +1

alyssa: +1; will start on dashboard items.

elaine: +1; will draft approval requirements for security review.

sanjay: Thanks. Scheduling RFC follow-up with details later today.
